# ADO202: template-not-resolved

A template wasn't expanded, so its contents aren't linted.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Templates and parameters |
| **Default severity** | info |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | template expansion |

## Description

Only local templates are expanded. Templates from other repositories (path@alias) and template paths built from expressions are skipped.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
steps:
- template: steps/build.yml@templates
```

Instead:

```yaml
# Lint the templates repository separately, or disable this rule.
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO202: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO202` or `--enable ADO202`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO202
```

## References

- <https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/devops/pipelines/process/templates#use-other-repositories>
